description: This Java source file defines the CreateConnection class, which represents a command to create a Connection within a connectivity model. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, serializing to JSON, and retrieving related connection details.

classes.name: CreateConnection
classes.description: A final class representing a command to create a Connection, extending AbstractCommand and implementing ConnectivityModifyCommand. It encapsulates connection data and provides serialization, deserialization, and accessor methods.

methods.name: CreateConnection.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CreateConnection instance with specified Connection and headers.

methods.description: Creates a CreateConnection instance from a JSON string or JSON object and headers.

methods.name: CreateConnection.getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Connection associated with this command.

methods.name: CreateConnection.getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category (MODIFY) of this command.

methods.name: CreateConnection.setDittoHeaders
